name: Review Write Operations
description: Before any write operation, verify it follows coding standards: immutability, proper error handling, no hardcoded secrets, and appropriate file size

then.prompt: Before writing this file, verify: 1) No hardcoded secrets or API keys, 2) Immutable patterns used (no mutation), 3) Proper error handling with try/catch, 4) File will remain under 800 lines, 5) No console.log statements in production code. If any violation is found, mention it before proceeding.
